positions.pos: A shadow spirit, the kind the WAVE run sends out with you when perceptual shadow shows up, cannot be dissolved. It has no element, so its mana has no stat to go to, and what it hides is still to be worked with. It walks with you until it is worked or let go. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: The perceptual shadow build sends shadow spirits out with no element (bars-engine #326). Dissolving pays mana into the stat each element grows fastest (sd-mana-to-stat). Your chat on perceptual shadow, 14 October: "It's hiding charge from the self so that it can't be dealt with or worked with."
